meta.name: Realm Dungeons Two

crimson_keep.title: Crimson Keep
crimson_keep.theme: A vampire count's castle: violet stone, red carpets, candlelight, blood pools.
crimson_keep.hazard: blood_pool: slows and drains HP over time; sprinkle near coffins and the throne.

hollowmoon.title: Hollowmoon Carnival
hollowmoon.theme: A haunted night fair: striped big-top walls, sawdust rings, boardwalk midways, lanterns.
hollowmoon.hazard: spin_tile: spins the player's movement direction while standing on it.

conch_hermit.ability: Retreats into its shell (blocks shots) when hit three times quickly, then pops out squirting.

burrow_mole.ability: Burrows under the field and surfaces next to a player, flinging dirt.

bandit_archer.ability: Keeps its distance from players and looses volleys of three arrows.

crag_dwarf.ability: A lamp-lit miner; throws his pick, then charges to pick it back up.

obsidian_scorpion.ability: Its cracked glass shell glows hotter as it is damaged; at low health its stinger shots split.

meta.notes: Two new dungeons (Crimson Keep, Hollowmoon Carnival) and five new realm enemies. Sheets are prefixed d2_ and ow2_; nothing clashes with earlier packs. Same conventions as before: x5 frames are 5x nearest-neighbour with a 1px outline (+1px padding per side); tiles are not outlined; tall decor pivots at its base tile; creatures face right; shots point right. Bosses are in atlas_bosses_two.json.

blood_bat.note: Fast, erratic swarmer; fires bat_screech rings.

gargoyle.note: Waits disguised as gargoyle_statue decor, wakes when a player comes near; throws stone_chip.

haunted_armor.note: Slow, tanky; stands as armor_stand decor until it wakes; swings crimson_slash.

blood_thrall.note: Shambling servant that rises from coffins; spits blood_spit, heals the Count in phase 1.

jack_in_the_box.note: Hops toward players, pops open to throw boxing_glove punches.

carousel_horse.note: Charges in straight lines; drops horseshoe shots as it gallops.

balloon_ghoul.note: Drifts slowly, fires grin_bubble; pops into confetti_pop on death.

knife_juggler.note: Keeps knives in the air and throws them in fans of thrown_knife.
